EV listens continuously through your microphone for the wake word "EVIE", and records what you say next when it hears it or when you press ⇧⌘E. Audio is used for wake detection, speaker verification, and your request, and is sent only to the EV backend you configure (127.0.0.1 by default).
EV turns the audio that follows the wake word "EVIE" into text so it can answer you. Recognition runs against the EV backend you configure (127.0.0.1 by default).
